The parent frames the full-suite + lint + typecheck gate as a per-shard obligation ('across every shard'), so the leaf's narrower gate redefines a parent deliverable rather than narrowing scope within it.
findings.finding: The leaf's no-behaviour-change AC narrows the parent's verification gate from 'the full test suite AND make lint / make typecheck pass unchanged across every shard' to merely 'the reconciler's tests pass unchanged', dropping the lint/typecheck gate and any tests outside the reconciler package that exercise its symbols.
findings.location: 9ce8 AC (supersedes list): 'No behaviour change: the reconciler's tests pass unchanged'
scenarios: A comment edit trips a ruff/mypy pragma or import-time check that reconciler unit tests do not exercise; the leaf's AC passes while the parent's gate would have caught it.
A test outside src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler imports a reconciler symbol whose docstring was collapsed and is read via introspection.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the leaf AC line with: 'No behaviour change: the full test suite AND `make lint` / `make typecheck` pass unchanged (per parent 373f's per-shard gate).'
